q: What was the root cause of the Stripe webhook failure?
a: request.json() parsed the body before signature verification — Stripe needs raw bytes

q: What safety pattern was enforced for Stripe objects?
a: Use getattr() instead of dict access — getattr(session, 'customer_details', None)

q: What happens if customer_email is None?
a: A warning is logged with the session ID, license generation and welcome email are skipped

q: What was the final commit message?
a: fix: webhook signature verification — use raw body, getattr on Stripe objects, null-guard customer email
